Horizon is a really fun Gorilla Tag fan game with a lot to offer! It has a big shop filled with cool cosmetics, so there's plenty to check out. The map is really cool and makes exploring the game enjoyable. There are also different game modes, including Rising Lava and Casual, which make the game even more entertaining. Overall, Horizon looks like a really promising VR game, and if you enjoy Gorilla Tag fan games, this is definitely one to try
